summary: Exzeo Group, Inc. filed an 8-K on August 14, 2026, announcing that its Board authorized a share repurchase program of up to $25 million of its common stock, subject to market conditions. The program, effective for one year, permits repurchases via open-market, block, privately negotiated, or Rule 10b5-1 trading plan transactions, consistent with Rule 10b-18. No specific share count or price targets were disclosed; management holds discretion on timing and amounts. The program may be suspended or cancelled without notice. Watch for actual repurchase execution levels in periodic filings as a proxy for management's valuation view.
